## Scope

Machine, part IDs or study, and technical reason for the change.

## Evidence

Reproduction, expected and observed results, units, assumptions, and open verification questions.

- [ ] Updated affected records, sources, and release evidence.
- [ ] Regenerated changed CAD and verified the review results.
- [ ] Ran lint, type checking, relevant tests, and the production build.
- [ ] Reviewed files and asset metadata for private data or unlicensed material.
